details: Batch for Mon Nov 23 sent, waiting for approval
summary: Over the last 7 days (Nov 16 to 22) 35 Trial Reels went out and 20 of them have readable numbers. The other 15 show 0 to 2 views, and every one of those is a book that had already been posted in the current format. The 20 counted reels drew 6,361 views in total, typically about 280 each. The typical 3-second hold is 18.7% of viewers (pooled over all views), down from 25.4% the week before (Nov 9 to 15, 33 reels, 14,994 views). In the current block, the O1 opening (a number fact about the book) holds 23.0% on 543 views from one reel. The O5 opening (language, binding and publisher) has no number yet because both of its reels show 0 views, so neither is ahead and the sample is too small to mean anything. Best recent reel by 3-second hold: Summarized Sahih al-Bukhari on Nov 16, 23.6% (358 views). Worst: Sharh Kashf ash-Shubuhat on Nov 17, 8.1% (125 views). Today's batch is day 2 of the same test: the same five books with the two openings swapped, O1 number fact against O5 edition fact.
